repo.description: Absolute checkout path on the managed host.

remote.description: Git remote used to recreate a missing checkout.

orca_binding.description: Optional legacy Orca registration name, read only by orca-legacy heads to find the project's existing Orca checkout. New projects have none, and reconcile neither creates, checks nor removes Orca registrations. It is never derived from id or repo.

curator_roots.description: Optional absolute historical cwd roots used only to route curator input after an ad-hoc checkout has been removed. They grant no execution authority.

enabled.description: Only true after a green onboarding gate.

integration_bases.description: Long-lived branches besides default_branch that this project integrates into and whose CI its workflows trigger for. A card's workspace.base_branch may name one of these or the default branch, and nothing else; a per-card branch is never an integration target.

plane.description: Routing plane for this project's cards.

code_concurrency.description: How many of this project's code cards may be active at once. Absent means 1; 0 claims none.
